summary.text: Christopher S. Friend is the incumbent Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 124 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A research chemist by training and a former Chemung County legislator, he was first elected to the Assembly in 2010.

paragraphs.text: Friend grew up in Big Flats and graduated from Horseheads High School, then earned a bachelor's degree in chemistry from the University of New Hampshire and a master's degree and Ph.D. in chemistry from SUNY Buffalo.
He worked as a research chemist before entering public service and, according to his official biography, published more than 20 scientific papers and symposium contributions.
Friend served on the Big Flats Parks Commission and was elected to the Chemung County Legislature before his election to the Assembly in 2010.

He represents the 124th Assembly District in the Southern Tier and is a member of the Corporations, Authorities and Commissions; Economic Development, Job Creation, Commerce and Industry; Local Governments; and Social Services committees.
His official biography says he lives in Big Flats with his wife, Renée, and their four children.
